name: yx-state-fundamentals
description: Apply the yx_state rules to Dart or Flutter code that uses the yx_state package. Trigger in any of these cases: (1) the user names yx_state, StateReadable, StateManagerObserver, StateManagerOverrides, or a StateBuilder, StateListener, StateConsumer or StateSelector widget; (2) the code imports package:yx_state or package:yx_state_flutter; (3) a state update was lost, duplicated or reordered in code built on it. Trigger on StateManager, handle, emit or a strategy name (sequential, restartable, droppable, concurrent) only where they appear as yx_state code - a class extending StateManager, a handle((emit) async {...}) call, a handler: argument - or next to yx_state itself. As bare words about another package they are NOT a trigger: bloc_concurrency uses the same four strategy names, and handle and emit are ordinary Dart. Do NOT apply to general Flutter state management questions about BLoC, Provider, Riverpod or setState when no yx_state code is involved.
